fan.basis: J501 thermal.fan: 9215-Y at full speed (12 V, 4000 rpm): 55.26 CFM free air, 2.87 mmH2O at zero flow (S06 p.2); straight-line curve between the two. Blows up: it pulls air in through the fin block's open sides and out through the lid grille (user, 2026-10-27, on the fitted cooler).

j501_operating_point.basis: J501 exports/simulation-checks.json (CFD, Rev 0.9-g48r, fins not calibrated): 16.21 CFM

agx_module.basis: the AGX Orin at its 40 W mode (J501 thermal.module.power_modes_w)

j501_carrier.basis: assumed: the carrier's regulators, NVMe, Ethernet

tep150_12.basis: the TRACO TEP 150-4812WI at about 70 W out (the J501 45 W, lidar, lights at 50 %, 5 V rail), 89 % efficient (D65)

vescs_mcu.basis: assumed: two Flipsky 75100 idling and driving gently, the MCU board, the VN-100

zeta.cells_basis: Idelchik thin perforated plate at the cells' open ratio
zeta.louvres_basis: Idelchik louvred grilles (1.6-2.4); the top of the range

design.louvres_where: the body's air inlet: each side wall's rear half beside the cooler's fins (x -112..-21), z 148..194 (under the deck's lip), above the J501's port hatch; 4 mm slots: ISO 13857 admits no finger (cad/body_shell.py LOUVRE)
design.rev_b_deck_cells: cells 8 mm square on a 10.54 mm pitch (2.54 mm webs: the sheet's thickness, SendCutSend's minimum) over the fan's whole circle (r 46), clear of the riser's feet; the turret plate's opening follows it
design.fan_duct: a printed PETG duct from the fan frame (2 mm clear of the fan, the J501's minimum_fan_clearance) up to the turret plate's opening, so the fan's exhaust leaves through the deck and does not spill back into the body to come round through the fins again (the J501 box re-breathed +3.5 K without its skirt)
design.flow_direction: up: louvres -> body -> fins -> fan -> duct -> deck cells -> riser sides (j501-agx 94da39d)

plate.basis: assumed thermal resistances (no published G48R curve): the thermometer test (B16) is the acceptance

cfd: not run: the J501 project's own Rev 0.9-g48r case is not calibrated (exports/simulation-checks.json: fins not calibrated, plate margin unknown); run it (j501-agx tools/thermal.py) once that case reports calibrated and steady, one heavy solver at a time on this machine (D61)
